scripts.dev:split: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=development concurrently -n auth,loc,ride,ntfy,gw -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @eve/auth" "npm run dev -w @eve/location" "npm run dev -w @eve/ride" "npm run dev -w @eve/notify" "cross-env GATEWAY_MODE=proxy PORT=4000 tsx watch gateway/src/server.ts"
scripts.build: prisma generate && tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/http/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/auth/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/location/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/notify/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/ride/tsconfig.json && tsc -p gateway/tsconfig.json
scripts.load:smoke: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000 load/health.js && k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000 --vus 5 --duration 20s load/lifecycle.js
